text: {"frames":["Femke the ferrywoman has not said a word since the fog rolled over the canal, but her blue lantern keeps swinging toward the Tower. You must reach the cheese loft before the wheel of cheese for the baker's wedding goes cold, and the lantern only takes the path drawn on the old plan pinned in her cabin. The first stretch crosses 2 squares of black water on a plank, the next runs over 4 squares of creaking boards, and the last climbs over 5 squares of sagging rope. Each square on the plan stands for 5 metres on the ground, so how many metres long is the whole route the lantern will take you?","Thijs the old lock keeper pulls the cupboard door open at midnight, and an old song hums out of the dark behind it. The tune leads to a secret trapdoor, and beneath it lies a canal where the water is still warm. Thijs has drawn you a route on squared paper, and it runs through the tunnel in 2 squares, along the glowing weir in 4 squares, and under the mill wheel in 5 squares. One square on his paper is 5 metres in the real Tower, so how many metres long is the whole secret route?","The bells in the herring stall have stopped, and the apprentice Sanne is wringing her hands because the market plan has gone wrong. Faraway music drifts up from the cheese cellar, and she is sure someone has moved the stalls. Her plan shows a path that starts with 2 squares past the waffle cart, goes on for 4 squares beside the ice-covered canal, and ends with 5 squares along the dyke to the Tower. Every square on the plan is 5 metres on the ground, so how many metres long is the path Sanne has to walk to put things right?","Smoke and warm waffles drift up the Tower stairs, and the cat Isa sits counting each step with her tail twitching. The water in the lock below rises and falls as if the whole canal is breathing, and the way out is only open between the beats. Isa has marked the route on the wall in chalk: 2 steps up the ladder, 4 along the tilting gangway, and 5 over the sluice gate. Each of her chalk squares is 5 metres of real canal, so how many metres long is the whole way Isa has to run to get out before the water rises?","In the crooked house with the hoist beam every window glows yellow, but the door is locked and nobody is inside. Luuk the keeper of forgotten things holds up an old plan with squares on it and taps the edge of the paper with a pencil. The lit path goes across 2 squares of tulip field, then through 4 squares of the windmill yard, and finally over 5 squares of cobbles to the glowing window. Each square on the plan stands for 5 metres in the Tower, so how many metres long is the route the glowing windows show?"]}
